verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents an API endpoint that returns the audit log trail for a case. Cases carry human decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected- accepted', 'risk detected- offboard'), and automated agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts, so both decision types exist. However, the evidence never shows that the audit trail records timestamps, actor identity, or which decisions were automated versus human. missing for 10: documented timestamp fields in the audit trail, explicit capture of automated/agent decisions alongside human ones, an audit field schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions

citations.quote: Returns the audit log trail for a case.
They can then select a case decision of ‘no risk detected’, ‘risk detected- accepted’ and ‘risk detected- offboard’.
The schema documents customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources.
